assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient is accompanied by transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these intermittent arrhythmic events with clinical symptoms and assess for potential embolic sources or hemodynamic instability
The service is documented in the clinical indication note
The service is directly related to the diagnosis codes I47.1 and G45.9
The payer denied the claim under reason code PR-204
The payer's denial is contradicted by the documented clinical justification
